title: Dana-RS Bluetooth connection fails on AAPS v3.4.0.0+ (Works on v3.3.2.1)
body:
**Issue Description:**
I am experiencing a Bluetooth connection issue with the Dana-RS pump on AndroidAPS versions 3.4.0.0 and above (including the latest 3.4.2.2).
When I tap the Bluetooth icon on the Pump page to initiate a connection, the progress timer counts up to 120 seconds but fails to connect. Repeating this process results in the same behavior.
The strange part is that version 3.3.2.1 and older versions work perfectly without any connection issues. Because of this, my daughter is currently forced to stay on version 3.3.2.1 to maintain a stable connection with her Dana-RS pump.

**Environment:**
- Phone: Samsung Galaxy S21 (SM-G991N)
- Android Version: 15
- AAPS Version: 3.4.2.2 (Problem persists in all 3.4.x versions)
- Pump Model: Dana-RS (Region: Korea)

**Troubleshooting performed:**
- Easy Mode: Confirmed as OFF in pump settings.
- Official App Test: The official Dana app connects to the pump without issues. 
   (I uninstalled the official app before testing AAPS to prevent Bluetooth conflicts).
- Bluetooth Reset: Attempted to reset the connection by tapping the Bluetooth icon in the AAPS pump page, but it did not work.
- System Unpairing: Removed the pump from the phone’s system Bluetooth paired devices list and tried re-pairing, but the issue persists.

I always appreciate your work. 
Best regards,
